classification.primary: vertically integrated retail florist, wholesale market and event business

evidence.observed: Official company history states operations consolidated in a 35,000 sq ft Phoenix facility and the business later added wedding/events and a wholesale division.
Official brands page lists retail Arizona Florist, LUX Wedding Florist, Arizona Flower Market, a B2B wholesale division and Geneva Fine Chocolate.

observations.claim_summary: Official history describes a centralized 35,000 sq ft Phoenix facility and multiple retail, event, market and wholesale brands.
Official brands page confirms retail, wedding/event, market, B2B wholesale and chocolate offerings under Arizona Family Florist.
observations.source_title: Arizona Family Florist — Family of Brands

observations.claim_summary: A SAF profile reported 40 full-time employees and up to 170 seasonal employees in 2012; it is historical and cannot establish current headcount.
observations.source_title: SAF / Floral Management — Arizona Family Florist profile

observations.claim_summary: Adapt lists an estimated 25–100 employee band and $1–10M revenue band; it is an aggregator estimate and conflicts with the much larger official operating footprint.
observations.source_title: Adapt — Arizona Family Florist contact profile

gmv_estimate.method: A 35,000 sq ft integrated retail/wholesale/event facility plus the historical 40-FTE operating signal supports a materially larger scale than low-end directory estimates; range brackets the internal $10M reference rather than replacing it.
gmv_estimate.validation_state: EXTERNAL_CANDIDATE; mixed retail/wholesale scope and current headcount require validation

buys_estimate.method: Hybrid model: 40%–65% of GMV to reflect retail/event product COGS plus B2B wholesale/market procurement; not externally observed procurement.

external_estimates.notes: Official 35,000 sq ft multi-brand operation plus historical 40 FTE signal; mixed retail/wholesale scope makes current revenue uncertain.
Derived from candidate GMV × 40%–65% to reflect retail/event product COGS plus wholesale/market procurement; not directly observed.

current_internal_estimate.validation_state: INTERNAL_MODEL; do not treat as observed actual

next_best_signals: Obtain current headcount or warehouse/route capacity from a reliable source.
Separate retail/event/market/wholesale revenue and procurement before using a single BUY ratio.
